scope: sixteen enumerated design requirements; not every possible implementation gap

designRequirements.remainingEvidence: Each module owner maps proposed operations to compiled native symbols, real consumers and package tests; no module deployment is certified by these profiles.
Re-read changed source blobs and complete all module native mappings; five inspected source locations are not forty qualified runtimes.
Memory owner implements and migrates the selected native backend; crash/reopen, witness, backup and restore tests run on the actual host.
Native implementations preflight sequence/capacity/encoding and prove no visible state mutation on rejected operations, including counter exhaustion.
Security and adapter owners implement serialized entry/revocation ordering, current epoch checks, non-retroactive terminal observation and bounded stop.
Native conditional-moment estimation and coefficient profile admission, operating-region tests and independent mathematical review remain required.
Native Rust and client conversion goldens, overflow behavior and protocol/profile migration remain required.
Independent observers and evaluator preregister real future windows, support, folds, precision/power, multiplicity and retained-task outcomes.
Implement versioned native graph types and test initialization/fallback acyclicity separately from declared runtime feedback and failure domains.
Native split/merge ownership registration, route publication, witness authentication, fault matrix and successor-delta-preserving rollback remain required.
Contract integrator admits versioned manifests and factories without changing a running generation or automatically granting new module ownership.
Implement native plant/controller ports, target timing measurements, scheduling assumptions, independent physical emergency stop and SIL/HIL tests.
External owner enrolls a real target and evaluator verifies service parity, resources, state migration and rollback; no target inherits consent or credentials.

designRequirements.topic: real C1 process and storage loop
designRequirements.remainingEvidence: Integrate named product callers, durable stores, independent outcomes, selected artifacts, new-process behavior change and safe rollback.
Freeze source/contracts and existing package DAGs, assign real owners and path leases, and retain exact-source/synthetic-merge evidence.
Complete repository verification, native integration CI and independent semantic review remain distinct from local Python/SQL oracle results.

closureRule: A document or local oracle cannot issue native, deployment, future-time, hardware, consent, independent acceptance or release evidence. Newly discovered gaps remain explicit.
